prompt:
If $| 5x - 15 | = 95$, what is the positive value of $x - 3$?

$$0$$

$$19$$
explanation: The correct answer is $19$. The given absolute value equation can be rewritten as two linear equations: $5x - 15 = 95$ and $-\left(5x - 15\right) = 95$, or $5x - 15 = -95$. Adding $15$ to both sides of $5x - 15 = 95$ gives $5x = 110$, so $x = 22$. Adding $15$ to both sides of $5x - 15 = -95$ gives $5x = -80$, so $x = -16$. Therefore, the two values of $x - 3$ are $22 - 3 = 19$ and $-16 - 3 = -19$. Thus, the positive value of $x - 3$ is $19$. Alternate approach: The given equation can be rewritten as $\left| 5\left(x - 3\right) \right| = 95$, which is equivalent to $5\left| x - 3 \right| = 95$. Dividing both sides by $5$ yields $\left| x - 3 \right| = 19$, so the positive value of $x - 3$ is $19$.
